➕ Add Staff Member
✅ Login Access: creating a staff member here creates their sign-in account and links it in one step — there's no separate "invite in Supabase, then paste a UUID" process anymore. Requires the create-staff-account Edge Function to be deployed.
ℹ️ Login credentials aren't changed here. This updates the staff record's details and role only.
ℹ️ Role Access Guide
🔴 Admin
Full access to all modules, settings, staff management, prices, and reports
🩺 Doctor
Consultation, orders, nursing, admissions, theatre, radiology, patient history
💉 Nurse
Vitals, nursing, fluid chart, admissions, handover, infection, sample collection
🔬 Lab Tech
Worklist, sample collection, all result entry pages, criticals, QC, TAT, inventory
🔬 Lab Supervisor
All lab tech access + result verification, QC management, lab history analytics
📋 Receptionist
Patient registration, appointments, billing, prices, infection flags
💰 Cashier
Billing, invoices, price list, appointments, patient registration
🔪 Theatre Nurse
Theatre bookings, pre/post-op assessment, nursing, admissions
🩻 Radiologist
Radiology requests, reporting, patient search, radiology results
🔐 Role Permission Matrix
Read-only — edit roles in code to change access

📲 Result / Reminder Delivery Log
SMS sent from the app (result-ready notices on All Results, appointment reminders on Appointments) — configure a provider under Settings → SMS / Messaging Provider first. WhatsApp/email delivery are not implemented.
Loading…
🏥 Hospital Identity
How long an invoice stays unpaid, or a patient routed to Admission stays un-admitted, before the notification bell flags it.
Open/Close Shift emails are sent to this address. Invoice discounts above this percentage require manager (admin) authorization before they can be saved.
🔌 Supabase Connection
📲 SMS / Messaging Provider
The gateway URL and API key are configured server-side only, as Supabase Edge Function secrets — see supabase/functions/send-sms — so the key is never stored in this browser. Run supabase secrets set SMS_API_URL=... SMS_API_KEY=... once to configure the provider. Sender ID isn't sensitive and can still be set per deployment here.
🤖 Lab Auto-Verification & Smart Rules Engine
OFF (default): every Haematology/Chemistry result requires a lab tech to manually review and verify before release — no automatic sign-off.
ON: a result auto-verifies and releases straight to the doctor's view only if it's within the reference range, triggers no Delta Check alert, the department's QC is currently passing, and it isn't a critical/panic value — anything else still falls back to manual sign-off. A Delta Check breach always blocks auto-verification and requires a mandatory reason code, regardless of this setting.
📅 Follow-Up Visit Policy
Controls the default follow-up date a doctor is offered when completing a visit (Consultation → Complete & Sign Off), and the pricing Reception is offered — never applied silently — when a patient with an open, unused follow-up registers again within this window.
💧 Nursing Safety Settings
Nursing's 24-Hour Fluid Balance Chart visually flags a patient once their cumulative net balance crosses this threshold — a fluid-overload risk cue for renal/cardiac patients. Never applied silently to any calculation, purely a visual flag on the chart.
🔑 My Anti-Fraud Override PIN
Lets you approve a void/refund/discount-override at the counter with a PIN instead of your full password. Stored as a bcrypt hash — never in plain text, never readable by anyone else, admin or otherwise. Requires migration_v2.12_override_pin.sql to be applied.
🛏 Bed Configuration
Loading…
⏱ Bed Turnaround SLA
How long a bed may sit in Cleaning/Maintenance on the bed grid before its tile visually escalates — a prompt for housekeeping/charge nurse follow-up, not an automated action.
🏁 Discharge-Readiness Flag
A rule-based badge (not a prediction) on Occupied bed tiles — a prompt for the charge nurse to check, never an automated action. Triggers when either: the patient's LOS exceeds their ward's own current average LOS by this margin, or discharge planning was started (the Discharge form was opened) but never finalized.
🩸 Blood Bank — Component Shelf-Life
Standard AABB shelf-life defaults (days), used only to pre-fill the expiry date when a unit is intaken — staff can always override it, the stored expiry date is never silently computed.
🔢 ID Counters
These counters generate every File Number, Lab No., and Radiology No. Correcting one only changes what the next number will be — it does not renumber existing records. Only use this to fix a genuine mistake.

📝 Precision Data Entry (EP15-A3)
Paste run data — one run (day) per line, replicate values separated by tab or comma (e.g. copy straight from a spreadsheet). Each Save & Calculate replaces this study's saved samples with whatever is currently pasted.
📝 Method Comparison Data Entry (EP09-A3)
Paste paired results — one specimen per line, Method X value then Method Y value, separated by tab or comma. Each Save & Calculate replaces this study's saved samples with whatever is currently pasted.
